COUNT counts rows or non-null expressions. SUM, AVG, MIN and MAX summarize values and normally
ignore NULL.

Interview question: COUNT(*) vs COUNT(column)?
Answer: COUNT(*) counts rows; COUNT(column) ignores NULLs.
